segments.text: The president of the Occult and Mysticism Research Club, one year senior to Takeru and Shiori. She is especially admired by Shiori, who belongs to the same club. She appears to be quite well-educated, with a gentle and calm personality, guiding Takeru and the others with mysterious power.

Second-year student of Akitsu High School. The protagonist of the main story. Due to certain circumstances, he lives at his cousin Shiori's house. For a long time, he has been tormented by mysterious nightmares, but with Mayou appearance, the situation gradually begins to change...

Japanese language teacher at Akitsu High School and homeroom teacher for Takeru's class. Beautiful with a great figure, she's the object of admiration for the boys. She's always calm and composed, but sometimes she reveals an unexpected side...?
A girl who transferred into Takeru's class during cherry blossom season. The main heroine of the main story. Judging by her enigmatic words and actions, she seems to know Takeru's grave secret...

Takeru's childhood friend and the only daughter of the Itsuki family, where he's staying. She's in the same class as Takeru. Her personality matches her appearance—bright and easygoing, yet strong-willed at heart. She belongs to the Occult and Mysticism Research Club, where Satoko serves as president.

He has been friends with Takeru and Shiori since they were little. He is the ace of the track and field club in high school. Despite his refreshing appearance, he tends to keep his worries bottled up inside. He even has a troublesome side where he won't open up to Takeru.
